item.tib: dmar khrid dgongs pa yongs phyag rdzogs dbu ma chen po gsum las rten pa gnas kyi btsal thabs lha yi khang bzang
item.coloph: ces pas phyag rdzogs dbu ma'i nyer mkho/ brten (rten) pa gnas kyi btsal thabs lha yi khang bzang bya ba 'di ni/ bla ma'i bka' lung bsten (brten) pa dang / grogs po rnams kyi (kyis) nan chen bskul ba'i ngor/ thos chung mu la ha ra'i (ras) dar rgyas g.yung drung gling du bgyis pa yi ge pa ni ngag dbang blo gros pa//
